thread:
maria: Heads-up: I'm going to roll a small RBAC refactor this afternoon to make GPU pool access namespace-scoped instead of cluster-wide. Goal is least-privilege + easier oncall debugging.

aj: +1. quick q — will this change selector labels on the Pool CRD or just rolebindings?

maria: Just rolebindings. plan is new role `gpu-user.namespace` bound to the namespace's service account via a controller we ship. No CRD schema change.

devon: Sounds good. Does the controller run in control-plane ns with impersonation? any KMS impacts?

maria: Controller will impersonate approver SA (svc-gpu-admin) to create RoleBinding in target ns. KMS: we expect no change for existing decrypt flow, but noticed a stun in staging where KMS decrypt for ephemeral tokens failed with 403 for a short window — raising to watchlist.

jen: Saw that 403 spike too. kubernetes audit showed `can-i` denied on `secrets/decrypt` path for the controller sa at 15:02:18. I captured logs: 
```
2026-03-19T15:02:18Z controller-1 audit: user="system:serviceaccount:infra:svc-gpu-admin" verb=update resource=secrets subresource=decrypt namespace=infra name=ksa-token-xxxx allowed=false reason="RBAC: forbidden"
```

nico: That suggests kube RBAC for the KMS wrapper secret isn't in the same ns or we dropped a clusterrolebinding in the last roll. Any recent RBAC PRs?

maria: There was #4124 last week to narrow the controller's clusterrole to a namespaced role, but it was supposed to be gated by feature flag. Looks like the flag didn't land. I'm reverting that change in staging now.

aj: Thx. If that revert is needed in prod we should do canary rollback path. deploy-bot: rollout started for rollback revision r2026-03-19-4124-revert.

deploy-bot: [info] rolling back deployment `rbac-controller` to r2026-03-19-4112-canary. ETA ~ 2m.

jen: For the longer-term plan: can we make the KMS decrypt permission only available via a dedicated kapp (ksa-crypt) in the infra ns and give the controller permission to Call/Assume that KSA only? reduces secret perms.

maria: Yes — proposal: introduce ksa-crypt with scoped `secrets/decrypt` in infra, then controller uses ServiceAccountTokenProjection + impersonation to call into it. That avoids giving controller broad secret update perms. I sketched RBAC in the PR description.

aj: Can you drop the sketch here? quick copy-paste would help reviewers.

maria: Sure — snippet below: 
```yaml
# Role in infra ns (ksa-crypt)
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: ksa-crypt-role
  namespace: infra
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "update", "decrypt"] # decrypt is a guard in our KMS wrapper
---
# RoleBinding for controller to impersonate ksa-crypt
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: controller-impersonate-ksa-crypt
  namespace: infra
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: svc-gpu-controller
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: ksa-crypt-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

devon: Nice. One nit: `decrypt` isn't a native verb — our KMS webhook maps `update` on secrets with annotation `kms/encrypted=true`. Let's keep rule to `get,update` and gate via annotation + audit policy.

maria: Good call. I'll update. Also adding audit annotation so we can filter decrypt ops.

kms-bot: [alert] 2026-03-19T15:05:42Z KMS latency spike detected across region-us-east-1 — 7s p95 decrypt.

jen: That aligns with the 403 window — degraded KMS + the RBAC narrow PR = ephemeral 403s while controller retried and hit fallback. No evidence of secret data exfil.

aj: Action items?

maria: 1) revert PR in staging (done) 2) rollout canary revert to prod if no regressions in 30m 3) land ksa-crypt design PR with updated verbs (get,update) + audit annotations 4) add automated smoke test that exercises controller's KMS path during CI deploys.

nico: I'll own the smoke test. tracking in #incidents/1234.

jen: I'll draft an incident note for the spike (no PII or data loss). include timeline + mitigations.

maria: thanks all. if you see any failed GPU job that looks like `RBAC: forbidden` ping this thread and tag @maria. :thumbsup:

aj: 👍

devon: LGTM

deploy-bot: [success] rollback r2026-03-19-4112-canary finished in 45s.

maria: I'll open PR for the ksa-crypt changes and link here. end of chain.
